comments.author: krishnaverma001
comments.body:
Hi! I've prepared a fix for this issue. My branch is available at:
https://github.com/krishnaverma001/rich/tree/fix-table-title-typing

Changes include:
- Updated `Table.title` and `Table.caption` typing from `TextType` to `RenderableType`
- Added tests in `test_rule_in_table.py` and `test_table.py`

This allows users to pass `Rule`, `Panel`, or any renderable as table titles.

Could someone please review my changes or add me as a collaborator so I can open the PR?

Thank you!
